intent: Brief supplementary text on hover or focus of a trigger element.
useWhen: Explaining an icon or abbreviated label
Non-critical context that should not clutter the layout
doNotUseWhen: Essential instructions — put them in visible hint text via Field
A sentence or two of help — use HelpPopover
Large content or forms — use Modal

requirements: Tooltip content available to assistive tech on focus

doNot: Do not hide required form labels in tooltips
snippet: <Tooltip content="Export includes all projects"><Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Export</Button></Tooltip>
